subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Tomar nota em discussões, debates, palestras, apresentação de propostas, reuniões, como forma de documentar o evento e apoiar a própria fala (que pode se dar no momento do evento ou posteriormente, quando, por exemplo, for necessária a retomada dos assuntos tratados em outros contextos públicos, como diante dos representados).

components.description_pt: Tomar notas durante eventos orais como debates, palestras ou reuniões para documentar informações-chave
components.description_en: Take notes during oral events such as debates, lectures, or meetings to document key information
components.cc_component_description: Take brief notes on sources while researching a topic

components.description_pt: Usar notas tomadas em evento oral para embasar próprias contribuições naquele evento
components.description_en: Use notes taken during an oral event to support one's own contributions within that event
components.cc_component_description: Cite specific textual evidence during discussions to support contributions

components.description_pt: Organizar notas de evento oral para permitir retomada de tópicos em contextos públicos subsequentes
components.description_en: Organize notes from an oral event to enable revisiting addressed topics in subsequent public contexts
components.cc_component_description: Take organized notes from sources and categorize information by topic or subtopic

cc_matches.description: Recall information from experiences or gather information from print and digital sources; take brief notes on sources and sort evidence into provided categories.

Come to discussions prepared, having read and researched material under study; explicitly draw on that preparation by referring to evidence from texts and other research on the topic or issue to stimulate a thoughtful, well-reasoned exchange of ideas.
Recall relevant information from experiences or gather relevant information from print and digital sources; take notes and categorize information, and provide a list of sources.
